AboutPage.title: Ko Wai Mātou
AboutPage.subtitle: Ko AOSSIE (Te Auahatanga me te Mātauranga Pūmanawa Tuwhera o Ahitereiria) he whakahaere kore-whai-hua kua rēhitatia (ABN: 32 743 493 466), e whakapau kaha ana ki te rangahau me te whakawhanake i ngā pūmanawa wātea, tuwhera hoki, me te ako i ngā mātāpono me ngā tikanga o te whakawhanake pūmanawa tuwhera. Ko te auahatanga te aronga matua o ā mātou kaupapa i ngā wā katoa, ā, he maha ngā wā e kaha ana te rangahau. Ko ā mātou puna pūmanawa me ā mātou taupānga katoa he 100% wātea, he tuwhera hoki.
AboutPage.p1Desc: Ko te auahatanga te aronga o ā mātou kaupapa, ā, he kaha te rangahau, mai i ngā stablecoin kua manatokohia ōkawatia ki te atamai hangahanga matatapu-tuatahi e rere ana i tōu ake pūrere.
AboutPage.p2Desc: E ako ana mātou i ngā mātāpono me ngā tikanga o te whakawhanake pūmanawa tuwhera mā te tuakana i ngā kaiwhai wāhi i roto i ngā kaupapa tūturu me ngā hōtaka pērā i a Google Summer of Code.
AboutPage.p3Desc: Ko ia puna pūmanawa, ko ia taupānga e hangaia ana e mātou, he 100% wātea, he tuwhera hoki, ā, ka whakawhanakehia i te aroaro o te katoa, i te taha o tō mātou hapori.
AboutPage.partnersTitle: Ngā Kaitautoko Pūtea, ngā Hoa Mahi me ngā Kaitautoko
AboutPage.partnersSubtitle: Ka taea a AOSSIE i ngā whakahaere e tuku pūtea ana ki ō mātou kaiwhai wāhi, e mahi tahi ana hoki ki a mātou i runga i te pūmanawa wātea, tuwhera hoki.
AboutPage.partnerProjects: {count, plural, one {# kaupapa kei ōna pūranga} other {# kaupapa kei ōna pūranga}}
AboutPage.gsocDesc: Ko Google Summer of Code te hōtaka o Google puta noa i te ao e tuku pūtea ana ki ngā kaiwhai wāhi hou kia mahi i ngā kaupapa pūmanawa tuwhera i raro i te ārahitanga a ngā tuakana. Kua whai wāhi a AOSSIE hei whakahaere tuakana mai i te tau 2016, ā, ko ia te whakahaere tuangahuru te rahi o te ao mā te tapeke o ngā kaupapa GSoC kua oti.
AboutPage.stabilityDesc: E hanga ana a Stability Nexus i te hangarau blockchain mō te pūmautanga ōhanga, ahumoni hoki. Kua noho hei hoa mahi ki a AOSSIE, ā, kua whakawhanakehia ētahi o ā mātou kaupapa Google Summer of Code, pērā i ngā oracle, ngā whakawhitinga me ngā taputapu kohi pūtea, ki roto i te whakahaere GitHub o Stability Nexus.
AboutPage.djedDesc: E tautoko ana te Djed Alliance i a Djed, he kawa stablecoin kua manatokohia ōkawatia. Kua mahi tahi ki a AOSSIE, ā, kua whakawhanakehia ētahi o ā mātou kaupapa Google Summer of Code, tae atu ki ngā whakatinanatanga o te kawa Djed me te widget utu StablePay, ki roto i te whakahaere GitHub o Djed Alliance.
AboutPage.waysSubtitle: He maha ngā huarahi e taea ai e tō whakahaere te mahi tahi ki a mātou. Whakapā mai, ā, ka kimi tahi tātou i te huarahi e tino hāngai ana.
AboutPage.way1Desc: Tukuna he pūtea mō ngā hōtaka tuakana mō ngā kaiwhai wāhi hou, pērā i te Australian Winter of Code e rapu kaitautoko pūtea ana mātou hei whakahaere.
AboutPage.way2Desc: Mahi tahi mai ki a mātou i te rangahau me te whakawhanake. Ka taea e ō mātou kaiwhai wāhi me ō mātou tuakana te hanga kaupapa pūmanawa tuwhera i te taha o tō kapa.
AboutPage.way3Desc: Tukuna he ratonga, he taputapu, he rauemi rānei e āwhina ana i ō mātou tuakana me ō mātou kaiwhai wāhi ki te hanga, ki te whakamātau, ki te tuku pūmanawa wātea.

Timeline.title: Tō Mātou Haerenga
Timeline.subtitle: Neke atu i te tekau tau e whakamana ana i ngā kaiwhai wāhi kia whai pānga pai.
Timeline.m1Desc: E toru o ngā kaupapa tuatahi e whā a AOSSIE (Skeptik/Scavenger, Carbon Footprint for Google Maps, me Mind the Word) i whakatinanahia e Tākuta Bruno Woltzenlogel Paleo, ā, i tīmata te whai wāhi ki GSoC i raro i te whakahaere CSE@TU-Wien.
Timeline.m2Desc: Nā Tākuta Bruno Woltzenlogel Paleo i whakatū Te Auahatanga me te Mātauranga Pūmanawa Tuwhera o Ahitereiria (AOSSIE).
Timeline.m3Title: Te Whai Wāhi Tuatahi ki GSoC
Timeline.m3Desc: I whai wāhi motuhake a AOSSIE ki Google Summer of Code mō te wā tuatahi, e tuakana ana i ngā ākonga puta noa i te ao. Ko te kaupapa pōti hiko a Agora te kaupapa tuawhā, ā, i noho hei kaupapa matua a AOSSIE.
Timeline.m4Desc: I rēhitatia a AOSSIE hei whakahaere kore-whai-hua i Ahitereiria (ABN: 32 743 493 466) i raro i te Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC).
Timeline.m5Desc: I tīmata a AOSSIE ki te whakawhānui nui i tōna pūnaha hauropi me ngā kaupapa hou e whakamahi ana i te blockchain me te atamai hangahanga.
Timeline.m6Title: Te Whakahaere GSoC Tuangahuru te Rahi o te Ao
Timeline.m6Desc: Ko AOSSIE te whakahaere tuangahuru te rahi o te ao, mā te maha o ngā kaupapa GSoC kua oti ia tau, mā te tapeke hoki o ngā kaupapa kua oti, i roto i te rōpū neke atu i te 600 whakahaere.

Team.title: Tō Mātou Kapa me te Hapori
Team.subtitle: Ko AOSSIE e whakahaeretia motuhaketia ana e tētahi rōpū tūao ngākau nui, arā, ngā kaiwhakahaere, ngā kaitiaki, ngā tuakana, ngā kaiwhai wāhi me ngā mema o te hapori.
Team.r1Desc: E ārahi ana i te ahunga o ngā kaupapa, i ngā arotake hoahoanga, me te tūāhanga pūmanawa tuwhera.
Team.r2Desc: E ārahi ana i ngā ākonga i roto i a GSoC, i ngā arotake waehere, i te tuhi tono, me te tipu hangarau.
Team.r3Desc: E tuku ana i ngā pull request, e whakatika ana i ngā pepeke, e whakatinana ana i ngā āhuatanga, e tuhi ana hoki i ngā tuhinga.
Team.r4Desc: E mahi tahi ana puta noa i a Discord, Telegram me GitHub hei poipoi i te auahatanga pūmanawa tuwhera.

ProgramsPage.title: Ngā Hōtaka
ProgramsPage.subtitle: Ngā huarahi ki te ako, ki te whai wāhi, ki te tipu hoki i te taha o AOSSIE.
ProgramsPage.gsocDesc: He hōtaka a Google Summer of Code puta noa i te ao e kawe mai ana i ngā kaiwhai wāhi hou ki te whakawhanake pūmanawa tuwhera. Ka mahi ngā kaiwhai wāhi i tētahi kaupapa i raro i te ārahitanga a ngā tuakana o tētahi whakahaere pūmanawa tuwhera. Kua whai wāhi a AOSSIE hei whakahaere tuakana mai i te tau 2016, ā, kei roto ia i ngā whakahaere GSoC nui rawa o te ao.
ProgramsPage.gsocApply: Me pēhea te tono ki AOSSIE
ProgramsPage.internDesc: E wātea ana mātou ki te tuakana i ngā kaiako mahi i ō mātou kaupapa katoa. Whakamōhio mai ki Discord ko tēhea kaupapa e hiahia ana koe ki te mahi, ā, mā mātou koe e hono ki ōna tuakana.
ProgramsPage.internCta: Hono mai ki tō mātou Discord
ProgramsPage.awocDesc: E rapu ana mātou i ngā kaitautoko pūtea me ngā hoa mahi hei whakahaere i tētahi Australian Winter of Code, he hōtaka pūmanawa tuwhera ā-tuakana e whai ana i te wairua o GSoC. Mēnā e hiahia ana tō whakahaere ki te āwhina kia tutuki ai, whakapā mai ki a mātou.

Stats.title: Tō Mātou Pānga Pai i ngā Tatauranga
Stats.subtitle: Ko mātou te whakahaere tuangahuru te rahi o te ao (i roto i te rōpū neke atu i te 600 whakahaere) mā te tapeke o ngā kaupapa Google Summer of Code kua oti.
Stats.mainStatDesc: E whakamana ana i ngā kaiwhakawhanake me ngā ākonga ki te hanga rongoā pūmanawa tuwhera e whakawhirinakitia ana, mai i te tau 2016.
Stats.stat1Desc: E hanga ana i ngā rongoā pūmanawa tuwhera auaha puta noa i te ahumoni, te mātauranga me te kāwanatanga.
Stats.stat2Desc: Hono mai ki tō mātou hapori kaiwhakawhanake o te ao ki te mahi tahi, ki te tiri whakaaro, ki te tipu tahi hoki.
Stats.stat3Desc: He pūranga kakama e pupuri ana i ngā anga, ngā puna pūmanawa me ngā taputapu o te pito mata o te hangarau.
